about: The component tokens a look can change, in the advanced editor: the sizes, fonts, colours and corners of the parts of the interface. The values the sizes give them (Compact, Comfortable; Standard is the CSS's own) are in modules/formulize/include/appearance_sizes/. A token's Default is not here: it is the value the CSS declares (modules/formulize/templates/css/formulize-ui.css, or a theme's own tokens). Each token's type says how its values are written in CSS; the token's own min and max (in the type's steps), or its list of values, are what it can be set to, chosen so that every value in the range changes how things look. Read by modules/formulize/include/appearance_tokens.php. The screens, components and gaps are for the advanced editor (modules/formulize/appearance_editor.php): the sample screens a theme can provide, the parts of the interface that can be selected in them and the tokens of each part, and what can't be adjusted yet. A part with a site setting is part of a look's branding rather than a set of tokens (the logo). A part that is a region of the page (the page, the side menu) is outlined inside its edges when it is pointed at or selected, since its edges are under what is beside it. A colour token's value is one of the site's colours (colours) or #rrggbb; its text says it is a text colour. A keyword token's labels name each of its values. A token's derived are the tokens written from it when it is set, %s being its value. A token's phone is the token used for it at 768px and below; its home is the part a shared token belongs to; its floor is the least it can be given another token's value (one line of a text token at a line height, plus extra px; or another token plus a number of steps).

spacing.description: A number of spacing steps (--fz-spacing, 0.25rem), in half steps.

text.description: A step of the text scale.

leading.description: A line height, as a multiple of the text size.

font.description: The font a kind of text is set in: the main font (--fz-font-sans) or the secondary font (--fz-font-heading), as the Appearance page sets them.

colour.description: A colour: one of the site's colours, by its name in colours below, which follows the Appearance page's colours; or a colour of its own, as #rrggbb.

radius.description: A corner radius, in px. 999 is fully rounded, for a token whose full is true.

keyword.description: A CSS keyword, such as a list's markers or whether links are underlined: one of the token's own values, which its labels name.

line.description: The thickness of a line, in px.

label.name: Field label

row.name: List row

Badges and other things inside cells.
Selected rows, which follow Primary.
